subject: s-proj
title: S.PROJ.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-8, one page after the passage where Braxton states 'the reality of creativity is related to the vibrationaltory particulars of a given projection — which is to say, creativity corresponds to the cosmic secrets of what a given projection potentially is about.' S-PROJ (source projection) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information): the question is how projection from cosmic source ends up as multi-information. Besides the main line to MT-INFO, one branch leaves the subject: PRIN-INFO (principle information) → COS-P (cosmic particulars). COS-P carries two lines: one to VT-U-FUND (vibrational universe fundamental) → SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) → AFL (affinity alignment), the other to PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → METH.
